sources.title: Tiger Leaping Gorge 2026: How to Visit, Hike, Itinerary, Map - China Highlights
sources.content:
Tiger Leaping Gorge: Complete Information

Overview
Tiger Leaping Gorge is one of the world's deepest gorges at 3,790 meters deep - approximately twice the depth of the Grand Canyon. The gorge stretches 23 kilometers between Qiaotou Village and Daju Village, located midway between Lijiang and Shangri-La in Yunnan Province.

Three Gorge Sections

Upper Gorge: The narrowest section featuring rapids and steep landscapes. Accessible via either a "well-paved plank path" along the Jinsha River for short visits (1-2 hours) or the High Trail for hiking (1-2 days).

Middle Gorge: Recommended for energetic hikers, featuring dramatic terrain including Teacher Zhang's Trail, the Tiger Leaping Rock, and the Sky Ladder - a "vertical" 168-step metal ladder approximately 20 meters high.

Lower Gorge: Not recommended due to plain scenery and abandoned, overgrown trails.

Hiking Routes

Recommended 2-Day Trek:
- Day 1: Naxi Family Guesthouse to Halfway Guesthouse (15 km, 5 hours)
- Elevation gains from 2,200m to 2,670m, featuring the challenging 28 Bends
- Day 2: Halfway Guesthouse to Tiger Leaping Rock (5 km, 4-5 hours)
- Mostly downhill with steep final descent

1-Day Alternative:
Tea Horse Guesthouse to Halfway Guesthouse (5 km, 2 hours) offers "the most stunning scenery" with "mostly flat terrain."

Best Visiting Times

September-October: "The comfortable season" with temperatures 12-25C. Pleasant weather with high river flow post-rainy season and colorful autumn foliage.

November-March: Dry season with clear snow-capped mountain views. Fewer visitors, temperatures 3-20C.

April-May: Temperatures 15-26C with blooming flowers.

June-August: Rainy season when landslides may close trails.

Transportation
From Lijiang: Approximately 86 km, 1.5-2 hours driving. Bus options available but require WeChat booking.
From Shangri-La: About 106 km, approximately 3 hours.

Entrance Information
Upper Gorge Scenic Spot requires entrance fees. Middle Gorge trails require separate tickets.

Practical Tips
- Altitude: Maximum trail elevation of 2,670 meters poses minimal altitude sickness risk
- Footwear: Non-slip hiking shoes essential
- Facilities: Supply points along trails offer drinks, water, and fruit
- Sky Ladder: Not recommended for those afraid of heights

What to Bring
20-30L backpack, quick-dry clothing, windproof jacket, non-slip hiking shoes, trekking poles, knee braces, sun protection, gloves, snacks, water bottles, and power banks.

sources.title: Tiger Leaping Gorge Trek: A Detailed 2026 Hiking Guide - Nickkembel Travels
sources.content:
Tiger Leaping Gorge Trek: A Detailed 2026 Hiking Guide

Tiger Leaping Gorge is located on the Jinsha River (an upper Yangtze stretch), positioned "60 kilometers north of Lijiang and 80 kilometers south of Shangri-La city." The canyon reaches "3790 meters from river to the highest peaks flanking it" and spans approximately 15 kilometers.

Getting There from Lijiang:
The gorge is technically in Shangri-La county. Regular buses depart from Lijiang Bus Station to Qiaotou. As of 2026, trekkers must get off at Tiger Leaping Gorge Scenic Area Ticket Office, then take a taxi (RMB 25 per person) up to Naxi Guesthouse in Nuoyu Village to start.

Hiking Route Sections:
1. Trailhead to Nuoyu Village
2. Nuoyu to 28 Turns section
3. 28 Turns to Tiger Leaping Rock and Bendiwan
4. Bendiwan to Jiantang Village (trail endpoint)

Key Landmarks: Tiger Leaping Rock, Halfway Guesthouse (recommended for overnight stays), multiple waterfalls.

Important 2026 Updates:
- The side hike to Tiger Leaping Stone has been totally closed as of 2026
- Access rules for Middle Tiger Leaping Gorge appear to have changed and may continue to change
- Luggage transport to trail's end is available
- Connection buses continue to Shangri-La from trail terminus

The author completed this trek mid-2025 and provided updates for 2026.

sources.title: Tiger Leaping Gorge Hike: Complete 2026 Trail Guide - The Fabryk
sources.content:
Tiger Leaping Gorge Hike: Complete 2026 Trail Guide

Tiger Leaping Gorge stands out as one of the world's deepest and most awe-inspiring river canyons in Yunnan province. If you like your hikes dramatic, scenic, and a little chaotic, this one's for you. You get stunning cliffside views, old-school guesthouses, goat traffic jams, and the chance to climb terrifying metal ladders bolted to a rock wall.

The classic trek begins at Qiaotou Town and continues northeast for 20-plus kilometres. Most hikers spend the night in a guest house along the way. A popular route involves doing the zigzag path down to the Tiger Leaping Gorge, spending time by the gorge taking photos, then climbing back up via the terrifying ladder path (known as the 168 Steps for the Brave).

Best Time to Hike: Late March to early June and September to early November. These months offer milder temperatures and less rain.

Difficulty: Despite its daunting appearance, the trails are surprisingly beginner-friendly, though weather in the gorge is famously unpredictable.

The most challenging section is the 28 Bends on the first day. The Halfway Guesthouse is very popular, so remember to book in advance.

On the first day of the hike, elevation changes are significant as you climb from the river level up to the high trail.

sources.title: Tiger Leaping Gorge, Lijiang: Travel Tips & FAQs 2026
sources.content:
Tiger Leaping Gorge: Travel Tips & FAQs 2026

Tiger Leaping Gorge is one of the world's deepest canyons, located between Lijiang and Shangri-La. The gorge divides into Upper, Middle, and Lower sections.

Best Time: Late March to early June and September to early November for optimal hiking conditions.

Transportation: Regular buses from Lijiang Bus Station to Qiaotou (2-3 hours, 25-35 RMB, running 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM).

Hiking Duration: 1 to 2 days typically, with the full trail stretching about 22 kilometers one way. Most hikers take 2-3 days.

The 28 Bends is the most challenging section. The Halfway Guesthouse is the most popular overnight stop.

Weather is famously unpredictable - pack layers for any conditions.

sources.title: Exploring the Tiger Leaping Gorge in Yunnan China - Feastography
sources.content:
Exploring the Tiger Leaping Gorge in Yunnan China, Most Beautiful in the World!

Tiger Leaping Gorge is described as another scenic viewpoint near the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, on the opposite side near Shangri-La. The gorge features dramatic cliffs and the rushing Jinsha River.

The gorge is accessible from both Lijiang and Shangri-La sides. Visitors can choose between a short visit to the Upper Gorge viewing platform or a multi-day hiking trek along the High Trail.

The author describes the views as comparable to Blue Moon Valley in terms of natural beauty.

sources.title: 虎跳峡景区 - 百度百科
sources.content:
虎跳峡景区 - 完整内容

基本信息
虎跳峡景区是国家AAAA级旅游景区，位于云南省迪庆藏族自治州香格里拉市虎跳峡镇。是"世界上最深的峡谷之一，中国最美十大峡谷之一"。

地理特征
虎跳峡全长23千米，落差213米，海拔高差3596米以上。峡谷两岸雪山对峙，左岸为香格里拉市的哈巴雪山，右岸为丽江市的玉龙雪山。江面与两岸雪山高差达3700-3900米，比美国科罗拉多大峡谷还深1500多米。

名称由来
受两岸高山的紧紧束缚，江流入峡后宽仅50多米，最窄处虎豹一跃即过，故名虎跳峡。

景区分段
分为上虎跳、中虎跳和下虎跳三段。

气候
属"温带和寒温带季风气候，年平均温度4.7-16.5°C"。"一山有四季，十里不同天。"

生物多样性
迪庆地区拥有125种哺乳动物、337种鸟类和4485种维管植物，被誉为"地球基因库"和"世界花园之母"。

旅游开发
1992年对公众开放。2009年获AAAA级景区认定。"虎跳峡徒步路线"被列为"世界十大经典徒步线路"之一。

游客信息
- 开放时间：8:30-17:30
- 门票：全票45元；学生票22.5元
- 距丽江：80公里

sources.title: Tiger Leaping Gorge Hiking Guide 2026 - East China Trip
sources.content:
Tiger Leaping Gorge Hiking Guide 2026 - Best Trails & Essential Tips

Tiger Leaping Gorge is one of the deepest gorges in the world, located between Jade Dragon Snow Mountain and Haba Snow Mountain in Yunnan, China. The gorge is about 23 km long with a maximum depth of over 3,900 meters.

The hiking route is considered one of the world's ten classic hiking trails. The trail can be completed in 1-3 days depending on fitness level and desired experience.

Key sections:
- Upper Tiger Leaping Gorge: Most accessible, with paved viewing platform
- Middle Tiger Leaping Gorge: Most dramatic scenery, featuring the 28 Bends and Sky Ladder
- Lower Tiger Leaping Gorge: Least developed, not recommended

Essential tips:
- Book Halfway Guesthouse in advance during peak season
- Bring adequate water and snacks
- Wear proper hiking shoes with good grip
- Start early to avoid afternoon heat and crowds
- Be prepared for weather changes at any time
